summary: Elevated real yields (TIPS 10Y at 2.85%) and a firmer dollar (DXY near 101, +2.2% over two weeks) kept pressuring gold to fresh lows below its 50-day average. Equities held in greed as low volatility and a tech-led rally in QQQ masked notably weak breadth, while the TLT selloff deepened bond-market duration stress.
tweet: Sticky real yields and dollar strength kept gold in fear and bonds under pressure, while a narrow tech-led rally kept stocks in greed despite weak breadth.
